brief:
Footage documents the conditions facing Palestinians in Umm al-Khair, a community south of Hebron, according to Eye on Palestine. Residents face ongoing settler violence and Israeli military restrictions that constrain their daily lives and movement.

The village has long been a flashpoint between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers, with tensions periodically escalating into confrontations and property disputes in the area.
dek: Footage documents the suffering of Palestinians in Umm al-Khair, south of Hebron, amid ongoing settler violence and Israeli military restrictions.
title: Footage shows Palestinian suffering in Umm al-Khair under settler violence
